title: Court record key: judge registry
description: A judge registry, spec/court-record-key.md section 10.2. Proposed (P8), pending ruling (codexpublicus/exemplar#47): the shape of registry/judges.json, which this repository would publish for the courts it registers outside the United States. Every field 0.5.1 uses keeps its meaning, so the fixtures standing in for a consumer's registry validate unchanged; a file that names itself the published registry (registry: judges) also needs its version and spec fields. What the schema can't check: that each court code is in the court registry, that slugs are unique across courts and never renamed, reused or deleted, that the -ii suffixes follow first appointment, and that a later version keeps every entry of the one before.

version.description: CalVer snapshot version, YYYY.MM.DD[.N], or 'fixture' for a test fixture

propertyNames.description: The slug, the author rule of spec section 2.1

court.description: A court code from the court registry (spec section 4)

source-ref.description: Where a fact was seen: a CRK alias of a source record (cap:mass/150/0108-01), a file's content address (ni:///sha-256;..., RFC 6920), or a URL

name.description: The judge's name as the courts print it in a byline, without office

full_name.description: The judge's full name, for display

courts.description: The court codes the slug is registered for

offices.description: Proposed (P8): for each court in courts, the offices the judge held there, in order

printed.description: Printed forms of the name, each with the source it was seen in (spec section 10.2)

sources.description: Proposed (P8): what the entry rests on

office.description: The office as the court names it (Justice of Appeal, Chief Justice, President)

abbreviation.description: What the court prints after the judge's name for the office: J, JA, CJ, P, CJ (Ag)

from.description: The day the office began; a zeroed day or month as in spec section 6.2 where only the year or month is established

to.description: The last day the office was held; absent while it is held
